description: This PHP class 'ValidationUniqueDao' in the 'OrangeHRM' project provides a data access object method to verify the uniqueness of a value within a database entity, supporting optional matching by entity ID and other matching criteria.

classes.name: ValidationUniqueDao
classes.description: A DAO class for validating the uniqueness of entity attribute values in the database, extending the BaseDao class.

methods.name: isValueUnique
methods.description: Checks if a specified value is unique for a given entity and attribute, with optional filters for entity ID and matching field/value.
